motds.body: Break the rules. Change the game! Activate Overrides to switch up the game and explore areas inspired by gaming legends like Sonic, Tetris, and Pac-Man as the future of the Island unfolds.
motds.title: Fortnite: Override Is Here!

motds.body: Gifting the Override Battle Pass unlocks the Peril Peak Mali Style and matching accessories for both the gifter and the friend receiving it!
motds.tabTitle: Earn the Peril Peak Mali Style
motds.title: Earn the Peril Peak Mali Style

motds.body:
Power awaits in every Sprite. 
Extract them. 
Reveal their extraordinary hidden powers. 
Find rare variants scattered across the Island. 
Evolve them with Sprite Dust. 
Chase down the ones still missing from your collection. 
Track their stats and watch them grow stronger. 
Only the most dedicated will find them all. 
Rise through the ranks with the power of Sprites. 
Drop in and start the hunt. 
Earn your place. 
Rewrite the rules!
motds.title: Crack the Lobby Hack

motds.body: Activate an Override console to pick a modifier that rewrites the rules for the entire Island! Change the game with fun effects like Sonic Speed and Bighead Mode.
motds.tabTitle: How To Break the Rules with Overrides!
motds.title: How To Break the Rules with Overrides!

motds.body: Geno is causing glitches in Island systems, and it's supercharging the hunt for Sprites! Through August 20, summon Sprites without spending Sprite Dust, level Sprites twice as fast, track down Lucky Locators to help complete the Collection, and different Sprite variants are boosted each day.
motds.title: Stabilize the Zero Point

messages.body: Commanders, we've moved the Save the World message of the day to appear when you first log into Fortnite!
messages.title: Message of the day update
